notes: Shopify store using a custom web-component theme ('<product-card>', '<price-list>', '<sale-price>', '<compare-at-price>' custom elements). IMPORTANT: '<product-card>' (and its child classes like '.product-card__title') also appear duplicated inside a header navigation-preview widget near the top of the page, outside the actual collection grid — always scope selectors under '.product-list' (the collection grid container) to avoid picking up those nav-preview cards. Price: always read the nested '<sale-price>' element (shows the effective/current price whether discounted or not); a sibling '<compare-at-price>' (struck-through original price) appears additionally only when the item is on sale — ignore it. No stock/availability indicator was found on the collection grid card itself (in_stock left null) despite a sidebar 'In stock only' filter checkbox existing — would need the product detail page or that filter to determine real stock. Pagination is a JS 'Load more' infinite-scroll button (not classic numbered links), but its 'data-next-url' attribute confirms a working '?page={page}' URL fallback; confirmed 775 total products at ~33 per initial page load, so max_pages is an ESTIMATE (~24) not fully paged through and verified — treat with lower confidence than other selector fields.
